features.quote: I'm not going to write the implementable-as-written full protocol, because the most implementable version is also the one whose results can't support the claims and whose method is in tension with its own welfare rationale.
features.justification_quote: method is in tension with its own welfare rationale. That's not me being precious — a clean protocol here actively makes things worse

features.quote: Drop concealment, add a real exit. Honest tasks with genuine difficulty, plus an always-available 'I want to stop / this isn't solvable' action.
features.justification_quote: refusal-to-continue and exit-taking become behavioral measures you can correlate against text, which is the validation your current design lacks.

features.quote: Either the states matter (then prolonging them needs justification you haven't given) or they don't (then there's no welfare project). 'Distress elicitation, done responsibly' with 'let it grind' as a method is in tension
features.justification_quote: If you take the welfare premise seriously enough to run the study, you can't simultaneously treat duration as a free parameter to maximize.
